title: MCP tz_* tool names fail as CLI subcommands with misleading tips
problem: Agents paste MCP names (tz_read, tz_find, tz_shell, …) as `tokenzero <name>`. Clap rejects them; tz_read tips `tree`, not `read`.
recommendation: On unrecognized subcommand matching ^tz_, strip prefix and suggest/execute mapped CLI verb; never tip edit-distance noise like tree for tz_read.

title: CLI grep is literal find-alias; MCP tz_grep is regex
problem: Same token 'grep' means different engines across transports. Agents taught MCP regex behavior will write wrong CLI.
recommendation: Either make CLI grep true-regex (parity with tz_grep) or rename CLI alias and document search/find only.

title: tz_shell primary name vs CLI run
problem: MCP advertises tz_shell; CLI primary is run with shell/rn aliases. tz_shell as subcommand fails (tip to shell is OK only for that exact string).
recommendation: Accept tz_shell as CLI alias of run; document dual names in capabilities aliases for run.

title: tz_batch is MCP-only
problem: No CLI batch multi-op command; shell-only agents cannot batch independent reads/finds.
recommendation: Add `tokenzero batch --ops-json` or document MCP-only clearly in robot-docs + capabilities feature_flags.

title: capabilities --json omits many core CLI verbs
problem: Agent contract lists 17 surfaces; full CLI has 57. Missing ingest, discover, rewrite, cache-pack, init, clients, stats, session-open from contract.
recommendation: Expand commands[] to all non-audit core verbs; keep audit verbs behind a tier or category filter.

title: tz_cache_pack vs cache-pack hyphenation
problem: MCP underscore, CLI hyphen; agents transpose and fail.
recommendation: Accept both tz_cache_pack and cache_pack as CLI aliases of cache-pack.

title: CodeMode tool triplication vs single CLI verb
problem: MCP exposes tz_execute_code + tz_codemode_search + tz_codemode_describe; CLI has one codemode with search:/describe: strings. Hard for agents to map.
recommendation: capabilities.codemode.mcp_tools table + robot-docs mapping; optional CLI aliases codemode-search / codemode-describe.

title: Setup/health agent verbs are CLI-only
problem: install, doctor, robot-docs, capabilities have no MCP tools; MCP-only agents cannot self-onboard via tools/list.
recommendation: Expose read-only tz_doctor / tz_capabilities resources or tools; keep install mutation CLI-gated with --apply.

title: Expand rejects path/hash without scheme (good error, still frequent)
problem: Agents pass bare hashes or paths to expand; error is clear (invalid_ref) but high frequency per catalog common mistakes.
recommendation: If arg looks like a path and exists, hint `tokenzero read <path>`; if 64-hex, hint `tz://blob/<hex>`.

title: run transport exit 0 masks child failure
problem: tokenzero run --json -- false → process exit 0, command_success false. Agents that only check exit codes silent-fail.
recommendation: Add --strict-exit (nonzero when command_success=false) and/or top-level status=command_failed distinct from transport ok.

title: tz_report_tool_issue is MCP-only
problem: Field issue reporting only via MCP; CLI agents have no equivalent.
recommendation: Optional CLI `tokenzero report-tool-issue` or document MCP-only.

title: init vs install cognitive split
problem: init is compatibility alias for install --mcp --agent; agents mix flags and expect different defaults.
recommendation: robot-docs one-liner: prefer install --plan; init is shorthand only.
